history.name: Renaming a feature
history.description: A feature can be renamed without losing anything: its history stays attached, the documents footnote what it used to be called so a reader isn't left wondering where something went, and the reason the name moved is recorded alongside.
history.dev_notes: cmdRename; the previous name is derived by stateAt() from the naming entries, so the footnote needs no bookkeeping of its own.
